posts.name: Lokar Griman
posts.cooked:
FC prioritizing FW input broadcasters over paying customers is driving players away. Players are quitting EVE and cancelling their subscriptions because they feel their feedback—and their efforts to report bots—are being ignored. This problem is in other areas of space as well!

And banning only small group of them once year wont fix the issue.

EVE is a social game. When friends start quitting, others often follow. Why continue playing when the people you play with are no longer there?

FC should be more heavy-handed and ban/ dissolve entire alliances if need be. Make the players hold up the standard at kick members from corp/alliances anyone doing input broadcasters or something similar. Name and shame them publicly, if there doing it consistently.

I know this will probably fall on deaf ears, but someone has to voice these concerns until FC addresses them.
